explanation: The leaf-key law of one box-rejection try does not depend on the trapdoor (boxSample_eq), so both views equal an experiment that reads only B and the hashes B R (a key law defined with any covered trapdoor of A_phi, chosen classically). The trapdoors satisfy B R_phi = A_phi by sim_relation (attribute 0 for the real view; Wee's identity from the block identity for the simulated view). The leftover hash lemma (closeTo_binaryHash_bind) replaces B R by uniform in both; then A = c(W) + U is uniform for any shift c(W) (bijection), so the two ideal experiments are equal. CloseTo.trans/symm concludes.
